question: Which year has the highest average consumer confidence index?
query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, AVG(consumer_confidence_index) AS avg_cci FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY avg_cci DESC LIMIT 1;
answer: According to the data provided, the year with the highest average consumer confidence index (CCI) is **2007**, with an average value of **86.18**.
